summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its semi-annual report for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes routine financial statements, equity plan details, warrant and option activity, and a subsequent event related to a private placement in July 2026. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is indicated. This is an ordinary periodic report by a foreign private issuer.
